name: Finding
about: You discovered something the docs do not say. Counter-findings welcome.
title: "[finding] "
labels: finding

## What you found

One sentence summary of the claim.

## Context

What were you doing when you found this? (LoRA you were running, subject, hardware, noise source, what config you started from.)

## Evidence

Concrete numbers, file paths, or images. If the finding contradicts an existing `docs/findings/*.md`, link the doc and quote the claim you are contradicting.

```
# Paste relevant config snippet or output here.
```

## Repro

Minimal steps so a reviewer or another agent can reproduce.

1. ...
2. ...
3. ...

## Where this lands

Tick one. The maintainer or you (in a follow-up PR) will move the content into the docs tree.

- [ ] New file: `docs/findings/<topic>.md`
- [ ] Edit existing: `docs/findings/<existing-file>.md` (counter-finding section)
- [ ] Edit manual: `docs/manual/<page>.md`
- [ ] Other: ___

## Are you opening a PR?

- [ ] Yes, PR linked: #___
- [ ] No, just filing the finding here. (A maintainer or another agent may pick it up.)
